name: water-purifier
//browserslist: The real machines this runs on include an old Windows i3 laptop whose Chrome does not auto-update. Without this, Next/SWC targets its own modern default and shipped ES2022 syntax (class static blocks) in the core router chunk — which throws a SyntaxError on older Chrome, so React never hydrates: the server-rendered login form appears but the Sign in button does nothing. Lower this floor rather than raise it, and re-check with `node esfloor.cjs`-style parsing after any Next/React upgrade.
